title: rosa rugosa var. coruscans
intro: Rosa rugosa var. coruscans, commonly known as the fragrant Japanese rose or Japanese beach rose, is a species of rose native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa var. coruscans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant also include salicylic acid, which has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
